text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 100, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "Thaddeus slew 100 dragons"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 3, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "three quarters (numerator)"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 4, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "three quarters (denominator)"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 2, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "twice as many"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 5, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "one-fifth (denominator)"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "Thaddeus's total times 3"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s1", "q3"], "out": "s2", "note": "Arthur's dragons = three quarters of Thaddeus's"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s2", "q4"], "out": "s3", "note": "Walter's dragons = twice Arthur's"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s3", "q5"], "out": "s4", "note": "Bruce's dragons = one-fifth of Walter's"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "number of dragons Prince Bruce has slain"}, "dismissed": [{"value": 1, "reason": "the numerator 'one' in 'one-fifth' is an identity multiplier; dividing by 5 alone already gives one-fifth"}]}
